text:
sophia: Heads-up — planning to onboard halcyon-lite v2.1 into the model catalog tomorrow 10:00 PT. Need someone to own the deploy + smoke. Plan: canary 5% for 15m, then ramp to 100% if metrics stable. Rollback = alias -> v2.0 + scale down new pool.

jamal: I can take the deploy if the canary start is bumped to 10:10PT (need 10m to finish a rolling maintenance).

liam: I can be second pair of eyes + run smoke checks. What does the smoke checklist look like?

anika: Pinged infra for slot reservation. Also can someone post the pin command we use? I want to bookmark it.

deploy-bot: slot reserved: #slot-87 for org/eng-ml from 2024-05-05T17:50:00Z to 2024-05-05T19:00:00Z (matches requested window).

sophia: thanks — jamal OK for 10:10 works. Quick smoke checklist (short):
- sanity text gen (50 tokens, deterministic seed)
- kv-cache warmup via 10 short requests
- latency P50/P95 below threshold for pinned route
- sample eval on 20 prompts from prod promptset
- check token-cost delta < 10% vs v2.0

jamal: copying smoke script here: `scripts/smoke_halcyon_v2.sh` — it runs the gen checks + traces. Will post results to this thread.

liam: who has authority to rollback if we see regressions? I can trigger alias revert but need someone to OK scale action.

sophia: jamal or liam can rollback. jamal executes the revert, liam handles scaling rollback (scale down new pool).

anika: deploy command (catalog CLI):
```
redwood catalog pin --model halcyon-lite --version v2.1 --alias halcyon-lite:prod --canary 5 --canary-duration 15m
```

anika: add note — set `--preserve-kv-cache=false` for first warm start so we validate cold vs warm perf.

jamal: on it. I'll run smoke script at 10:10PT and paste output. tagging @liam so you're watching dashboards (latency/cost/quality). :thumbsup:

liam: watching APM and cost dashboard. I set alert thresholds: p95 > 800ms and token-cost bump > 12% -> page.

deploy-bot: canary traffic rule created: halcyon-lite:prod -> v2.1 (5%); monitoring hook -> eng-ml/observability/halcyon-canary.

jamal: smoke run complete (10:22PT) — all sanity checks passed, P50 120ms P95 320ms, sample eval looks good, cost delta +3%. Logs: small warnings about tokenizer mismatch (non-blocking). Posting output gist: https://gists.example/smoke-halcyon-v2.1

liam: looks good from my side. No regressions in eval samples. Recommend ramp to 100% at 10:30PT if no objections.

sophia: go ahead at 10:30PT. jamal please execute ramp and post final confirmation.

jamal: ramped to 100% at 10:31PT. Final checks: P95 steady, cost within expected. Leaving canary monitoring for 1h but closing the deploy handoff. :rocket:

anika: filing a short deploy note in the catalog changelog, will reference this thread.

liam: noted — thanks everyone. If anything odd, escalation path is page -> eng-oncall -> platform lead.

sophia: thanks team — great coordinated run.
